title: Sangokushi IV with Power-Up Kit
native_title: 三國志Ⅳ ｗｉｔｈ パワーアップ・キット
overview: Sangokushi IV with Power-Up Kit (三國志Ⅳ ｗｉｔｈ パワーアップキット) is a re-released version of Sangokushi IV for the Sega Saturn, adding the contents of the game's expansion pack (or "power-up kit" as it is known in this context).
